# Configuration

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

## Server

The server reads these from the environment or from a `.env` file in its working directory.

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `PREFLIGHT_DATABASE_URL` | `sqlite:///./preflight.db` | SQLAlchemy URL of the database. Use Postgres in production. |
| `PREFLIGHT_AI_PROVIDER` | `auto` | Which AI to use. `auto` uses Anthropic when a key is set, otherwise local Ollama. |
| `PREFLIGHT_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | unset | Anthropic API key. Never stored in the database. |
| `PREFLIGHT_ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` | unset | Override the Anthropic API URL. Tests point it at a local fake. |
| `PREFLIGHT_REVIEW_MODEL` | `claude-opus-5-5` | Anthropic model for project reviews. |
| `PREFLIGHT_SMALL_MODEL` | `claude-haiku-5-5` | Anthropic model for classification, rule drafting, and drill grading. |
| `PREFLIGHT_AI_MONTHLY_BUDGET_USD` | `5.0` | Refuse an AI call when its worst-case cost would pass this month's logged spend. |
| `PREFLIGHT_OLLAMA_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:11434` | Address of the Ollama server used when there is no Anthropic key. |
| `PREFLIGHT_OLLAMA_MODEL` | unset | Ollama model for reviews. Empty means the largest installed model. |
| `PREFLIGHT_OLLAMA_SMALL_MODEL` | unset | Ollama model for the smaller tasks. Empty means the review model. |
| `PREFLIGHT_OLLAMA_CONTEXT_TOKENS` | `32768` | Context size requested from Ollama. Long material is split to fit it. |
| `PREFLIGHT_CAPTURE_ALLOW_PRIVATE` | `False` | Allow capturing private and loopback addresses. For local testing only. |
| `PREFLIGHT_CAPTURE_BROWSER` | `False` | Render JavaScript pages in headless Chromium. Needs the `browser` extra. |
| `PREFLIGHT_RETROSPECTIVE_REQUIRED` | `True` | Require a retrospective summary to close a project. |
| `PREFLIGHT_RULE_OBSERVATION_DAYS` | `28` | Days a rule is observed before it gets a verdict. |
| `PREFLIGHT_REQUIRE_HTTPS` | `False` | Redirect or refuse plain HTTP, and mark cookies Secure. Set it in production. |
| `PREFLIGHT_SESSION_IDLE_MINUTES` | `720` | Dashboard sessions end after this much inactivity. |
| `PREFLIGHT_ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES` | `60` | Lifetime of a CLI access token. The CLI refreshes it. |
| `PREFLIGHT_DEVICE_CODE_MINUTES` | `10` | How long a `preflight login` code stays valid. |
| `PREFLIGHT_DEVICE_POLL_SECONDS` | `5` | Minimum gap between CLI polls during device login. |
| `PREFLIGHT_MAX_FAILED_LOGINS` | `5` | Failed logins from one address before that address is locked out. |
| `PREFLIGHT_LOCKOUT_MINUTES` | `15` | How long a lockout lasts. |
| `PREFLIGHT_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | `20` | Login and token requests allowed per client address per minute. |

## CLI

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `PREFLIGHT_API_URL` | http://localhost:8000 | Address of the Preflight server the CLI talks to. |
| `PREFLIGHT_CONFIG_DIR` | ~/.config/preflight | Where the CLI keeps its offline queue, and its token file when the keyring is off. |
| `PREFLIGHT_NO_KEYRING` | unset | Set to `1` to store tokens in a file readable only by you instead of the OS keyring. |

## Tools and tests

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `PREFLIGHT_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | unset | Password for `preflight-server create-user`, instead of the prompt. |
| `PREFLIGHT_TEST_DATABASE_URL` | sqlite:// | Database for `pytest`. The tests drop and recreate every table. |
| `PREFLIGHT_E2E_DATABASE_URL` | a temporary SQLite file | Database for `scripts/e2e.py`. |
| `PREFLIGHT_UPDATE_GOLDEN` | unset | Set to `1` to rewrite `tests/golden/review_payload.txt`. |
| `PREFLIGHT_TEST_OLLAMA` | unset | Set to `1` to run the test that calls a real local Ollama. |
